"""先核对并备份95份实际来源，再集成事前声明的11份矩形CHOLMOD来源。"""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT / 'knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm'
PLAN_SHA = '5f134f630f8f969097c2b9c2b85912a89b4f20ef224043303367d43754d1dd06'
BASELINE_SHA = '22f1b40f08a37ad1dcb62bd7a047581d637939c8dcd1cf0123102a64617a3048'

def digest(content):
    return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()

def sha(path):
    return digest(Path(path).read_bytes())

def read(path, expected):
    raw = Path(path).read_bytes()
    assert digest(raw) == expected, str(path)
    return json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8'))

def source(name):
    assert isinstance(name,str) and ':' not in name and '\\' not in name
    path = (ROOT/name).resolve()
    assert path.is_relative_to(ROOT) and path.is_file()
    return path

def save(path, value):
    with path.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(value,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
        f.write('\n')

parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--staged-sha256',required=True)
args=parser.parse_args()
plan=read(DATA/'v66-plan.json',PLAN_SHA)
baseline=read(DATA/'v66-baseline-check.json',BASELINE_SHA)
starting=read(DATA/plan['starting_state']['file'],plan['starting_state']['sha256'])
staged=read(DATA/'v66-staged-source.json',args.staged_sha256)
assert baseline['passed'] and baseline['files']==starting['files'] and baseline['libraries']==starting['libraries']
assert staged['plan_sha256']==PLAN_SHA and set(staged['files'])==set(plan['changed_source_files'])
assert len(staged['files'])==11 and len(baseline['files'])==95 and len(baseline['libraries'])==17
archive=DATA/'v66-starting-source.zip'
backup_identity=DATA/'v66-starting-source.json'
output=DATA/'v66-integration.json'
assert all(not p.exists() for p in (archive,backup_identity,output))
original={name:source(name).read_bytes() for name in baseline['files']}
assert {n:digest(v) for n,v in original.items()}==baseline['files']
assert {n:sha(source(n)) for n in baseline['libraries']}==baseline['libraries']
assert sha(ROOT/'build/release/solver.exe')==baseline['solver_sha256']==starting['solver_sha256']
parent=read(DATA/'ipm-v57-identity.json',plan['parent_identity_sha256'])
assert sha(ROOT/'.tools/solver-ipm-v57.exe')==parent['solver_sha256']
assert read(DATA/plan['evidence_file'],plan['evidence_sha256'])['passed']
assert read(DATA/plan['previous_iteration']['verification_file'],plan['previous_iteration']['verification_sha256'])['passed']
replacement={}
for name,item in staged['files'].items():
    path=source(item['path'])
    assert path.is_relative_to(ROOT/'.tools/v66-kernel') or path.is_relative_to(ROOT/'.tools/v66-integration')
    raw=path.read_bytes()
    assert digest(raw)==item['sha256'] and item['before_sha256']==baseline['files'][name]
    assert raw!=original[name]
    replacement[name]=raw
assert replacement['src/ipm.cpp'].count(b'ipm-cpu-0.53.0')==1
assert replacement['tests/test_cli.py'].count(b'cls.benchmark.platform.platform()')==1
assert b'homogeneous_extended' not in replacement['src/ipm.cpp']
for ref in plan['local_references']:
    assert sha(source(ref['file']))==ref['sha256']
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive,'x',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for name in sorted(original):z.writestr(name,original[name])
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
    assert len(z.namelist())==95 and {n:z.read(n) for n in z.namelist()}==original
save(backup_identity,{'created_at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'plan_sha256':PLAN_SHA,'baseline_check_sha256':BASELINE_SHA,'files':baseline['files'],
    'libraries':baseline['libraries'],'solver_sha256':baseline['solver_sha256'],
    'source_zip_file':archive.name,'source_zip_sha256':sha(archive),'source_count':95,
    'readback_verified':True,'lp_runs':0})
assert {n:sha(source(n)) for n in baseline['files']}==baseline['files']
assert {n:sha(source(n)) for n in baseline['libraries']}==baseline['libraries']
assert sha(ROOT/'build/release/solver.exe')==baseline['solver_sha256']
assert sha(DATA/'v66-staged-source.json')==args.staged_sha256
for name,raw in replacement.items():source(name).write_bytes(raw)
expected=dict(baseline['files'])
expected.update({n:digest(v) for n,v in replacement.items()})
assert {n:sha(source(n)) for n in expected}==expected
assert {n:sha(source(n)) for n in baseline['libraries']}==baseline['libraries']
assert sha(ROOT/'build/release/solver.exe')==baseline['solver_sha256']
result={'passed':True,'created_at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'plan_sha256':PLAN_SHA,'baseline_check_sha256':BASELINE_SHA,'staged_source_sha256':args.staged_sha256,
    'changed_source_files':plan['changed_source_files'],'source_count':95,'before_files':baseline['files'],
    'files':expected,'libraries':baseline['libraries'],'solver_sha256':baseline['solver_sha256'],
    'backup_source_zip':archive.name,'backup_source_zip_sha256':sha(archive),
    'backup_identity_file':backup_identity.name,'backup_identity_sha256':sha(backup_identity),
    'all_prechecks_completed_before_source_writes':True,'lp_runs':0,'build_runs':0,
    'integration_source':Path(__file__).read_bytes().decode('utf-8'),'integration_source_sha256':sha(__file__)}
save(output,result)
print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'changed_sources':11,'source_count':95,'backup_sha256':sha(archive),'lp_runs':0}))

"""保留第63轮每次调用的真实开始时间、退出、原始输出和执行源码。"""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT / 'knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm'
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('label')
parser.add_argument('script')
parser.add_argument('arguments', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
args = parser.parse_args()
assert args.label.startswith('v66-') and '/' not in args.label and '\\' not in args.label
target = DATA / (args.label + '.json')
assert not target.exists()
script = (ROOT / args.script).resolve()
assert script.is_relative_to(ROOT) and script.is_file()
source = script.read_bytes()
command = [sys.executable, str(script), *args.arguments]
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
begin = time.perf_counter()
process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONUTF8='1'), capture_output=True)
record = {
    'started_at_utc': started,
    'completed_at_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'command': command, 'returncode': process.returncode, 'elapsed_seconds': time.perf_counter()-begin,
    'source': source.decode('utf-8'), 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),
    'stdout': process.stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'),
    'stderr': process.stderr.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'),
    'wrapper_source': Path(__file__).read_bytes().decode('utf-8'),
    'wrapper_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
}
with target.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(record, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
    f.write('\n')
if process.returncode == 0 and args.arguments == ['self-check'] and script.name == 'v66-run.py':
    result = json.loads(record['stdout'])
    assert result['passed'] is True and result['solver_runs'] == 0
    with (DATA / 'v66-runner-self-check.json').open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'record': str(target), 'returncode': record['returncode'],
                  'elapsed_seconds': record['elapsed_seconds']}, ensure_ascii=False))
print(record['stdout'][-4000:])
if record['stderr']:
    print(record['stderr'][-4000:])
raise SystemExit(process.returncode)
